title: 2020 bonus-rewards template does not match the live badge
detail: play_collection_event still points at reference_images/oct_bonus_rewards.png. The live marker is a round monkey portrait with a number ribbon (100 on Beginner page 1, 40 or 60 on some Expert cards). Template search for the October 2020 icon will miss and should be logged as a failure, not treated as a missing event.
